blockingFindings.title: Optional failurePolicy exposure is tested as mandatory
blockingFindings.target: specs/290-acceptance-review-policy/tests/next-action-contract.test.js: R4 test `next-action exposes the public snake_case acceptance-review envelope`
blockingFindings.issue: R4 says `failurePolicy` may be exposed only as an additive field, but the test requires `failurePolicy` to be present in the next-action envelope and asserts its value. This turns an optional additive field into a mandatory public contract.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Relax the R4 test so it accepts the existing snake_case envelope with or without `failurePolicy`, and only asserts `failurePolicy === "amend-spec"` when the field is present.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The test encodes an incorrect implementation premise and would reject a valid implementation that satisfies R4 without exposing the optional additive field.
